provenance.label: Average Earnings, Hours Worked, Employment and Labour Costs
provenance.selection: All employees; unadjusted Employment, Weekly Earnings, Hourly Earnings, Weekly Paid Hours and Hourly Total Labour Costs; 2019Q1 onward. All published sectors retained, never summed across overlapping sector groupings.
boundaries: Public sector aggregates, not Waystone or employee-level data.
Survey coverage: enterprises with 3+ employees; all with 50+ and a sample with 3-49. Small enterprises below 3 employees are excluded.
Means are not individual salary benchmarks. Employment and earnings have different denominator definitions.
Hours are paid hours, not individual actual working hours or working-time compliance evidence.
Unadjusted quarter-on-quarter changes may reflect seasonality; year-on-year comparisons are descriptive, nominal and subject to revisions.
Missing published cells remain missing; no interpolation or imputation.
NACE K is a broad finance/insurance context, not a company-specific peer match.
Use the current survey methodology for current coverage; the general background page contains older legislation and register details.

requirements.skill: Large, imperfect datasets from multiple systems
requirements.evidence: Seven fictional feeds plus 130,536 public cube cells; 29,745 daily time rows. Analysis reads and validates the complete selected data, without sampling.
Hash-pinned JSON-stat decoding, typed CSV ingestion and validated one-to-one HR/payroll joins.
Whitespace/case keys, decimal-comma FTE, critical-field rejection, exact deduplication and conflicting-record quarantine.
Source-linked synthetic scenarios cover an effective-dated salary change absent from payroll, an unsupported movement and an approved increase.
Exact employee and approval lookups with explicit not-found markers; duplicate guards prevent first-match ambiguity.
Independent exact-match alternatives alongside XLOOKUP allow a reviewer to compare methods and missing-key treatment.
Nested IF/AND checks return ambiguous, missing, excluded, amount-exception or reconciled statuses; totals exclude unresolved gross.
Two refreshable native Excel PivotTables summarise reconciliation by department/result and case governance by type/status.
requirements.where: Workbook Â· Payroll Pivot Â· Case Pivot

requirements.evidence: Validated exception status list, input thresholds and visual exception highlighting support an auditable follow-up workflow.
Public sector time series and synthetic control counts use explicit denominators, unit definitions and year-on-year comparisons.
As-of active headcount and FTE exclude conflicting masters, critical-field failures, future starters and leavers. Exclusions remain visible.
requirements.where: Workbook Â· Dashboard Â· HR Master

requirements.evidence: Employment-aware weekday exposure and FTE-weighted scheduled/lost hours; union overlapping episodes and cross-check against worked-time records. No diagnoses or real health information.
Approved salary/FTE/components versus recorded gross; separate signed variance, absolute discrepancies, missing amounts, duplicate/conflicting groups and inactive recurring pay.
Approval-based controls reconcile supported salary and variable-pay changes and identify unsupported movement, stale salary and allowance mismatch.
Every exception has a source reference, owner, recommended action and review state; browser triage is labelled a simulation and never alters source records.

17-week mean-hours screening, completeness gates, logged daily-rest and break-duration reviews reference WRC guidance. Statutory calendar periods, leave adjustments, exemptions and weekly rest require further validation.
PIP case dates, owners, documentation and overdue reviews; no performance scores or automated decisions.
Proposed documentation and ownership escalation workflow. Practical case handling and specialist judgement require separate experience evidence.
Expiry windows, missing owners, renewal submission and evidence status, with analyst-set 30/90-day service thresholds. No passport, nationality or actual immigration records.
Proposed provider coordination, evidence verification, escalation and closure gates. Legal eligibility, application processing and sponsorship experience require separate evidence.
Proposed BambooHR CSV field mapping, effective dates, key contracts and import preflight checks. Implementation requires validation with the platform owner.
Hire/end dates drive reporting inclusion; future-starter and leaver payment checks require approval/settlement review.
Source-to-control process map, payroll sign-off gates and a source-linked investigation SOP included with the deliverables.
Fixed seed/as-of date, hash-pinned source, immutable raw feeds, rebuild commands and executed tests; all outputs regenerate from source.
A documented control design connects exception families to preventive checks, accountable owners and escalation/closure evidence. Operational impact requires post-implementation measurement.
Interactive public-data trends, reconciled-pay bridge, severity/area filters, absence heatmap and visa timeline with accessible data tables.
A proposed dimensional model and reporting measures are provided. Hands-on Power BI authoring requires separate evidence.
Proposed least-privilege workflow, restricted-case escalation and data minimisation. The project uses public and synthetic data; practical confidential-data handling requires separate evidence.
